Gauge zero 308.12 m NHN (DHHN2016). Past gauge zeros are not listed.
Commissioning dates of the Straubing and Geisling barrages upstream and any backwater effect at Pfelling: not found.
Our comparison with Hofkirchen shows the gap between the two gauges changing by about 20 cm over 1964 to 1966 at similar flows; cause not found.

public_notes: The level is measured against a fixed mark below the riverbed, not the depth of the water. Values from January 2026 on are raw readings that the Bavarian agency has not checked yet.
